claim: This paper does not warn that a speed read from a suspended particle's path is not the particle's speed. It does not discuss such a speed at all. The word Geschwindigkeit appears twice in the whole paper, both times before §4: the velocity components of the atoms of a system, in the statistical argument of §2, and the velocity \(K/6\pi k P\) that a force gives a sphere, in §3. Across §§4 and 5, printed pages 556 to 560, it does not appear. What §4 does say is a condition on the interval, and it is the only statement in the paper that bears on the question: the motions of one particle in successive intervals may be treated as independent of one another "solange wir diese Zeitintervalle nicht zu klein gewählt denken", as long as we do not think these time intervals chosen too small (p. 556). The quantity §5 asks a researcher to measure is a displacement in a stated time, \(\lambda_x = \sqrt{2Dt}\), 0.8 micron in one second and about 6 microns in one minute (p. 559), and never a distance divided by a time. The absence is worth recording because the reasoning behind the warning is on the page even though the warning is not: a displacement that grows as the square root of the time gives a speed that grows without limit as the interval shrinks, which follows from the result printed on page 559. Einstein drew that consequence in later papers, and which of them says what is a question about texts this edition has not read.
evidence: Checked by agent:claude-opus-5 on 2026-10-24, the resolution am-bm-margin-entries-7fa4 asks for under "The velocity-warning verification note". THE EDITION CHECKED AGAINST is the pinned facsimile public/papers/pdfs/ap-17-549.pdf, Annalen der Physik (4) 17, 549–560, whose SHA-256 matches docs/provenance/ap-17-549.md. The question was asked three ways and all three agree. (1) THE SOURCE BLOCKS: all 90 files under content/source-blocks/brownian-motion, which cover every live paragraph of the paper. Searched for Geschwindigkeit and every inflection, and for mittlere, Weg, Sekunde and zu klein. Two hits for Geschwindigkeit, at s2-p1 (Geschwindigkeitskomponenten of the atoms) and s3-p6 (the Stokes velocity); seven for mittlere, every one of them mittlere Verschiebung, a displacement; and the two zu klein are the §4 condition at s4-p2. The English side agrees: content/translation-units/brownian-motion holds two occurrences of velocity or speed in 162 units, in the units of those same two blocks. Five paragraph ids the manifest names have no block file, s2-p6, s3-p3, s3-p4, s4-p7 and s4-p8, and all five are RETIRED ids the manifest records as absorbed into their neighbours in the 2026-09-19 boundary audit, so the population searched is complete rather than short by five. (2) THE LEDGER: public/papers/transcripts/ap-17-549-machine-draft.txt, 12 pages, a second transcription of the same plates. The same two occurrences, at its lines 35 and 143; §4 begins at line 180 and §5 at line 271, so both fall before §4 and the two sections in question hold none. (3) THE PLATES: the page images of printed pages 556, 557, 558, 559 and 560, which is every page of §§4 and 5, read visually. No velocity word and no such warning on any of them, and the three paragraphs this note quotes stand on the plate as the two transcriptions give them. NO REVIEWED LEDGER EXISTS for this paper, so the second witness is a machine draft with hand correction and is named as one. NOT ESTABLISHED, and deliberately: this note makes no claim about what Einstein wrote in Ann. Phys. (4) 19, 371–381 (1906), Z. Elektrochem. 13, 41–42 (1907) or Z. Elektrochem. 14, 235–239 (1908). Nobody in this repository has read any of the three, none is among the pinned facsimiles, and none has a citation record, so where the explicit discussion of an apparent velocity first appears is open here. Two reader-facing readings already state it: content/editorial/readings-owners/am-bm-08-measurement-bias-h1ye.yaml gives bm-08 an r3 reading beginning "Einstein did warn, in 1906 and again in 1907" and bm-08-apparent-speed-noise an r3 reading beginning "Einstein pointed out in 1907". Those are claims about the three later texts and are not grounded by this check, which settles only the half about 1905. No human reviewer has checked any of it. WHERE THE PAGE IMAGES ARE: artifacts/page-images/ap-17-549-CORRECTED/parent-173.png to parent-184.png are printed pages 549 to 560. The directory named artifacts/page-images/ap-17-549 holds a different paper, offset by 41 pages: its page-08.png is printed page 515, "Kombinationen von Kapazitäten und Selbstinduktionen". A check that read the unsuffixed directory would find no velocity word there either, and would be measuring the wrong pages of the volume.
